scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:fixtures
scripts.check: npm run build && concurrently --success all --names packages,workspace "npm run check:packages" "npm run check:workspace"
scripts.check:workspace: concurrently --success all --names imports,experiments,suppressions,declarations,fixtures "npm run check:imports" "npm run check:experiments" "npm run check:suppressions" "npm run check:declarations" "npm run check:fixtures"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @microdelta/definition && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/tracking && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/history && npm run build --workspace microdelta
